entry.focal: A huge, dim, oblique orange-brown slab (the ice wall proxy, unlit) filling the left half, and the teal pool; the hut on the right is a grey box with two lantern bars.
entry.next_visible: The hut (warm lanterns) on the right; the return door is not visible.

reveal.focal: The ice wall seen square across the pool. Its framing is the best in the group, but it's brown and unlit; the pool is the only lit surface.
reveal.next_visible: The return door at far left as a small dark opening with one lantern; the hut lanterns on the right.

concept.focal: The teal pool and the grey hut with two lantern bars; the brown ice wall at upper left. The layout loosely matches concept 17 (ice left, hut right) but there's no blue and no black-vs-blue contrast.

strip.focal: The strip only walks the 13 m from the east-corridor door to the return door along the west wall: mostly the dark back of the ice slab and dark walls. The pool is seen sideways at strip-6/7.
strip.next_visible: Return door is reached, but no warm noren marks it (the noren is 8 m up).

fixes.detail: ice_formation has no light (no 'light' key), so the brightest-coldest hero is an unlit brown wall. Add a strong blue backlight (emissive translucent ice plus a ~3000-5000 W area light at ~10000 K behind or inside it) and icicle proxies hanging over the pool. Move it dy -1.0 so its base rises straight out of the pool's north rim as in concept 17 and the brief.

Noren snapped to the cave ceiling at z -11.84, about 8 m in the air. Put it on the door head: z centre about -17.85 (bottom at about -18.3 under the 2.6 m door). Light it warm from behind so the way back to the steam reads from the hut.

18 boulders evenly spaced round a perfect r 8 circle make a necklace. Group them: 5-7 big ones (scale [0.9,1.6], some half in the water) on the SW foreground arc (bearing ~200-260 from the pool centre) to frame the entry/concept view; a dense jumble at the ice foot; and an open arc toward the entry door (bearing ~250-290) so the view across is clear. Remove dressing0:9, 0:10 and 0:11, which sit between the pool and the ice.

The hut renders as a cold grey box; its 150 W area light doesn't show. Its pool-facing front needs warm emissive shoji and an open engawa edge so it is the one warm counterpoint (concept 17 right side).

A perfect r 8 circle reads as a fountain basin, not a cave plunge. Proposed for layout.json (the lead's file): make it irregular and run its north edge up to the ice (y ~93) with a rocky inlet under the drip line. This is a shared-file change for the lead to make.

top_change: Light the ice wall from behind in strong blue so it becomes the brightest thing on B1 and the room flips from 'dark brown wall' to 'glacier'.
plausibility: Return noren floats at z -11.84 (8 m above the floor) instead of over the 2.6 m door.
hut_steps: 5 risers x 0.17 = 0.85 m down from the 0.45 m hut floor ends at about -20.4, inside a pool whose bed is -21.3. The steps stop 0.9 m above the bed; add 3-4 risers or a submerged landing.
Room is a flat-ceilinged box with a bright rectangular ceiling patch (likely a light leak), not a vault/cave.
The ice wall stands on dry floor about 1.2 m back from the pool, so the meltwater 'fall' line at y 92.6 drips onto rock and boulders rather than into the pool.
